column5: The rotation transform is confined to ShapeLayer, while the candidate identifies both the active DOM renderer’s missing rotation and GPU shapes drawing unrotated despite rotation-aware hit tests.
The text editing listener calls raw hitTest(shape, event.worldPoint), while shape registration uses withRotation(hitTest), causing rotated text editing hit tests to disagree with selection.
The sticky editing listener calls raw hitTest and sends POINTER_DOWN only on a hit, bypassing the withRotation wrapper used in shape registration.

Unlike the general executor, which forwards effect.target, Phase 8 writes facts to each rule target regardless of the effect's specified recipient.

Both listApiKeys and createApiKey use requestV3, which logs their full secret-bearing responses when debug is enabled.
Both API-key methods route responses through requestV3's unredacted debug logging, exposing listed and newly generated keys.
The reported leakage is requestV3's debug logging of generated keys from createApiKey and returned keys from listApiKeys.
Both endpoints pass secret-bearing responses to requestV3, whose debug logger prints the entire parsed response without redaction.
